initiative.title: Recorded QA Acceptance — dock-react gesture verification

mission: Prove the beep qa recording/extraction/judging system end-to-end on the dock-react pointer fixes, including a falsification round demonstrating true-positive detection.

completionGate.statement: Achieved 2026-08-01 on amended criteria (see README lane-decision and falsification rows): clean structured Lane A rounds on the fixed build (worktree rounds 5 and 11, requiredCount 0), judge-lint and evidence cross-check green on every round, and live-fire true-positive evidence (five real defects caught that harness assertions missed). Lane B retired as structurally human-gated; Lane C (Xvfb + XTEST) proven and graduated to a follow-up packet along with the smear-capable fixture.
